messages:
cleo (docs): Quick PSA  PR #7342 updates rate & quota snippets to the new header and fixes a broken pricing CSV link. Could someone eyeball before I merge? https://confluence.redwood/internal/docs/quota-pricing
devin (eng): Which header did you pick? Also which dashboard panel are you linking to?
cleo (docs): Using `x-rw-usage-plan` everywhere. Added a one-line migration note: 'Legacy header x-rw-quota maps to x-rw-usage-plan.' cURL example in the PR:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\\\
  -H 'x-rw-usage-plan: team' \\\\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
hao (pricing): Docs should use 'grace credits' in user-facing text (internal teams may say burst). Also add a short pricing note: 'Tiers are billed per-token with slabed rates; see CSV for boundaries.'
devin (eng): Panel id is `usage-plan-7`, metric `tokens_consumed_total`. Suggest adding this PromQL so readers can reproduce the chart:
```
sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{plan=~"(pro|team|enterprise)"}[5m])) by (plan)
```
cleo (docs): Great, I'll paste both the migration line and the PromQL into the analytics section. Adding a tiny JS fetch snippet too.
docs-ci: docs-ci: lint started for PR #7342
docs-ci: docs-ci: lint passed ✅
cleo (docs): Merged PR #7342 and added redirect for old CSV path. Thanks all, closing thread.
